featured_reviews.name: minal karkera
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really bad experience. I would recommend please find some other qualified physiotherapist and don't believe all the 4-5 star reviews because even we trusted them.

Sharing the experience below:-
My mom had a minor shoulder pain (muscle stiffness). Doctor suggested physio therapy sessions (2-3 should be enough). We visited Prakruti physiotherapy clinic. Dr. Dimple used IFT machine initially and showed some exercises in first two sessions. Then on the third session, she asked her assistant to do cupping therapy, which caused complete discomfort, redness and swelling. She disregarding it saying it's good for blood circulation.

In the next session, we confronted the physiotherapist, she said - Redness will go away, it's good that the pain is shifted from shoulder to arms and my mom's skin is sensitive, so there is nothing to worry about (completely false claims)

The pain was so severe we had to visit orthopedic again. He said cupping therapy was completely unnecessary, only simple exercises were needed. He gave painkillers to reduce the pain in her arms (he also added that pain is due to tissues tear/ damage in the right arm).

Highly disappointed with such kind of unprofessional service. Please don't visit this clinic if you don't want your loved ones to suffer more and end up taking painkillers for additional pain.
